title: sse: fix streaming chunking & framing for partial JSON + delimiter/token ordering
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Fixes several edge cases in the SSE streaming encoder that caused partial JSON responses to be emitted with incorrect delimiter ordering or token/event interleaving. Background: our OpenAI-compat streaming surface emits two kinds of events (token events and delimiter/partial-json flush events). Under certain batching and backpressure conditions partial JSON fields could be flushed out-of-order (delimiter lines after token events), leading to downstream JSON reparsers and client SDKs mis-parsing the stream. This PR stabilizes the ordering, introduces a small output buffer for partial-JSON frames, tightens the flush conditions, and adds deterministic tests. Changes include encoder logic, integration tests that replay the incident trace, metrics to detect future regressions, and a docs note about streaming ordering guarantees. Checklist:
- [x] Add deterministic unit tests for token/event ordering
- [x] Add integration replay test covering the incident trace (packet loss + slow consumer)
- [x] Fix encoder flush ordering and buffering logic
- [x] Add CI job to run streaming e2e in flaky-mode on PRs touching encoder
- [x] Update OpenAI-compat streaming docs with ordering guarantees
Related Linear: ENG-5123 ENG-5301. This was regression observed in production (see incident INT-2019). The patch is scoped to the streaming encoder and OpenAI compatibility adapter; no API surface changes expected for existing clients.

review_comments: Oliver Chen: Found a race where the "flushDelimiter" path could be invoked after token emission under backpressure - suggested single-path flush that serializes both token and delimiter emission.
Aisha Kumar: Reworked the encoder to centralize flush logic in serializeAndEmit(); added a small ordered buffer to hold delimiter frames until the next emission boundary.
Priya Nair: Please add a regression test that replays the original packet timings from INT-2019 - thanks for adding the replay harness.
Marco Silva: LGTU after tests and CI e2e stabilize; noted minor style nits fixed in follow-up commit.

release_notes: Fix SSE streaming framing that could produce partial JSON delimiter ordering issues under heavy backpressure; improves stream stability for OpenAI-compat clients. No breaking changes.
notes_for_ops: Added a streaming_order_mismatch metric (counter). Ops: watch for spikes in streaming_order_mismatch after rollout; rollback if spikes persist >1% of streams for 15m.
related_incident: INT-2019 (packet-loss + slow-consumer caused clients to receive malformed partial JSON events)
testing_summary: Unit tests cover edge cases for delimiter/token interleaving; integration replay test replays incident trace and asserts strict ordering; CI added flaky-mode e2e that runs streaming harness under network jitter. All tests green after two CI retries.
documentation_changes: docs/openai-compat/streaming.md updated to document deterministic ordering guarantees between token events and delimiter frames; example client parsing guidance added.
